description: The Graceful is Louis Vuitton's classic hobo, a soft single-shoulder bag with a gently curved top, an open magnetic-tab closure, and a wide flat strap that sits comfortably on the shoulder. It is most recognizable in Monogram and Damier Ebene coated canvas with a colored microfiber lining and a hanging leather name tag. Introduced in the Fall-Winter 2017 collection, it is one of the house's everyday underarm bags, offered in PM and MM sizes.

The Grand Shopping Tote, widely known by collectors as the GST, is Chanel's large open-top day tote in quilted caviar calfskin, carried by two chain-and-leather handles with a CC logo on the front. It has a roomy unstructured body suited to everyday and work use, without a flap or turn-lock closure. Chanel discontinued it around 2015, which pushed it into strong demand on the resale market. GST is the community and trade name; Chanel identifies its seasonal bags by style code rather than an official model name.
note: Discontinued ~2015. GST is the trade/community name; Chanel does not officially name most seasonal bags (per brand-naming-research). Debut year not cleanly sourced.

description: The 30 Montaigne is Dior's structured shoulder bag defined by an oversized antique gold-tone CD clasp on the front flap and an embossed 30 Montaigne signature, named for the house's historic address at 30 Avenue Montaigne in Paris. Designed by Maria Grazia Chiuri and introduced in 2019, it is most often made in smooth box calfskin with a curved flap and an adjustable leather strap. It quickly became one of Dior's core modern icons and now spans a full line of sizes and materials.

The Hamilton is Michael Kors' signature structured satchel, a boxy top-handle tote with a hanging padlock and key detail and a lock-charm turn closure at the center. First introduced in 2009 and inspired by a vintage travel bag Michael Kors found at a flea market, it is carried by two top handles or an optional shoulder strap. It became one of the brand's defining accessible-luxury bags and anchors the Hamilton line across saffiano leather and other finishes.

The Cabas is Celine's minimalist open-top shopper, a large, soft, unstructured tote carried by two flat leather handles, made in smooth or grained calfskin and usually kept logo-light with at most a small embossed Celine stamp. It comes in vertical and horizontal shapes across several sizes, built for roomy everyday and work use with no closure. Celine also makes a separate winged Cabas Phantom, an open-top version of the structured Luggage, so this name spans both the plain Cabas tote and the Phantom.
note: Listings under this style are mostly the plain minimalist Cabas tote (vertical/horizontal/soft cabas) plus some Cabas Phantom; described as the plain Cabas, which dominates. Year held null.

description: Le Cagole is Balenciaga's revival of its mid-2000s motorcycle bag, a soft slouchy crescent-shaped shoulder bag drenched in studs, buckles, tassels, and aged distressed leather, with a heart-shaped mirror charm and a zip pouch. Designed by Demna and introduced in 2022, it deliberately reworks the codes of the classic City bag for a new generation. It is worn on a single shoulder strap and comes in a wide range of vivid seasonal colors.

The Multi Pochette Accessoires is Louis Vuitton's modular crossbody, a hybrid that combines a full-size Pochette Accessoires, a smaller mini pochette, and a round coin purse worn together on one strap. Built in Monogram coated canvas with a mini Monogram pattern on the pochette sides, it ships with both a removable gold-tone chain and an adjustable wide leather strap so the pieces can be styled separately. It launched in 2019 and became an instant cult release with long waitlists.

The Mon Tresor is Fendi's mini bucket bag, a small drawstring pouch with a rounded body, a cinch closure, and a raised FF logo, typically in calfskin with gold-finish hardware. It comes with detachable straps so it can be worn crossbody or on the shoulder. It sits in Fendi's lineup of compact everyday bags under Silvia Venturini Fendi.
note: Debut year not cleanly sourced; widely dated to circa 2019 but held null rather than assert.

description: The Business Affinity is Chanel's structured quilted flap with a top handle and a chain-and-leather shoulder strap, made in diamond-quilted caviar calfskin with a CC turn-lock closure and a boxy, ladylike profile. It was introduced in the Spring/Summer 2017 collection and offered across mini, small, and medium sizes. Business Affinity is the trade and community name; Chanel identifies its seasonal bags by style code rather than an official model name.
note: 2017 is the seasonal debut. Business Affinity is the trade/community name; Chanel does not officially name most seasonal bags.

description: The Lady D-Joy is a modern derivative of Dior's iconic Lady Dior, reinterpreting that bag in a lower, more elongated horizontal format while keeping its hallmarks: topstitched Cannage lambskin, rounded top handles, and the hanging D.I.O.R. letter charms. Designed under Maria Grazia Chiuri, it reads as a sleeker, more contemporary spin on the classic. It is offered in several sizes and seasonal finishes.
note: Lady Dior derivative. Debut year not cleanly sourced; held null.

description: The Papillon is Louis Vuitton's cylindrical barrel bag, a rounded tube-shaped handbag in Monogram coated canvas, historically sold with a matching detachable mini pouch inside. First introduced in 1966 and credited to Henri Racamier, it gained fame through a 1967 advertising campaign and remains one of the house's most recognizable vintage silhouettes. It is carried by rolled top handles and has appeared in numerous sizes and reissued versions since.

The Dior Toujours is a large, soft, roomy tote conceived by Maria Grazia Chiuri and unveiled at the Dior Spring-Summer 2023 show, presented as a new everyday house icon. It is an unstructured shoulder and hand tote in supple calfskin with a cinched, gently gathered top and hanging Dior charms. It leans into practicality and volume rather than rigid structure.

The Bobby is Dior's flap shoulder bag from the house's Fall 2020 collection, named after Christian Dior's own dog. It has a soft curved crescent flap, a wide leather strap, and a distinctive gold-tone jewelry-style clasp and D charm, most often in smooth calfskin though also in shearling and jacquard. Designed by Maria Grazia Chiuri, it reads as an easy, saddle-adjacent everyday flap.

The Lady D-Lite is a canvas derivative of Dior's iconic Lady Dior, translating the bag's Cannage relief into embroidery on jacquard or canvas rather than quilted leather, while keeping the rounded top handles and hanging D.I.O.R. letter charms. Designed under Maria Grazia Chiuri, it is a lighter, more casual everyday take on the classic and has appeared in the house's Toile de Jouy and Around the World motifs. It is offered in several sizes.
note: Lady Dior derivative. Debut year not cleanly sourced; held null.

description: The Telfar Shopping Bag, nicknamed the Bushwick Birkin, is a minimalist unisex tote in vegan leather with an embossed interlocking T logo on the front, dual short top handles and a longer crossbody strap so it can be worn multiple ways. Designed by Telfar Clemens, it made its debut in the Fall-Winter 2014 show and reached cult status from 2017 onward as a symbol of accessible, democratic fashion. It comes in small, medium, and large sizes and a rotating range of colors.

The Loop is Bottega Veneta's compact crossbody camera bag, a small structured pouch in the house's signature Intrecciato woven leather with a knotted strap detail and a zip top. It was introduced during Daniel Lee's tenure and continues in the current lineup, worn on a long shoulder or crossbody strap. It is one of the house's more accessible everyday leather bags.
note: Daniel Lee-era design; exact debut year not cleanly sourced, held null.

description: The Caro is Dior's chain shoulder bag introduced in the Fall-Winter 2021 collection, built in supple Cannage-quilted calfskin with a twisting CD-signature lock clasp on the front and a removable CD-link chain that lets it be carried by hand, on the shoulder, or crossbody. Designed by Maria Grazia Chiuri and named after Christian Dior's sister Catherine, nicknamed Caro, it has a soft slouchy body with a back slip pocket. It is offered in several sizes and finishes.

The Roulis is Hermès' compact structured shoulder bag, introduced in 2011, recognizable by its rounded flap and a slim turn-lock clasp derived from the house's Chaine d'Ancre anchor-chain motif. Its name evokes the roll of a ship, in keeping with that nautical heritage. Worn on a single adjustable leather strap, it is often positioned as a lighter, more understated alternative to the Constance.

The Fendi First is Kim Jones' debut signature bag for Fendi, first shown in the Fall/Winter 2021 collection. Its defining feature is an oversized asymmetric F clasp that acts as both closure and frame, giving the bag a soft, puffy, coin-purse-like body and a slanted silhouette. It is carried by a top handle or a shoulder strap and is offered in nappa leather and several sizes.

The Hammock is Loewe's shape-shifting shoulder bag, designed under Jonathan Anderson, built with side panels that can be tucked in or released to transform the silhouette from a slim structured bag to a fuller, slouchier one. It is handcrafted in the house's signature calfskin and comes in a range of sizes including mini, small, and larger versions. Its collapsible, convertible construction is its signature.
note: Debut year conflicts across sources (cited variously 2015 and 2018), so held null rather than assert.

description: The Re-Edition is Prada's line of reissued Y2K-era bags, reviving iconic nylon styles from the house's 2000 and 2005 collections, and reintroduced from around 2019 as Y2K fashion returned. The best known is the Re-Edition 2005, a small nylon mini hobo with a zip top, a triangle enamel logo, and a top handle, now made in Prada's recycled Re-Nylon. The line spans several silhouettes and materials rather than a single model.
note: Line/category, not a single model. Original designs date to 2000 and 2005; revived circa 2019. Year held null because it spans multiple debuts.

description: The Triquilt is a quilted flap bag in Saint Laurent's Envelope family, made in leather worked with the house's triple-quilt technique and closed with a flap bearing the metal Cassandre YSL monogram. It is carried on a pull-through chain-and-leather strap that can be doubled or worn long, under Anthony Vaccarello. It reads as a structured evening-into-day chain bag.
note: Variant within the Saint Laurent Envelope line (Envelope debuted Resort 2018); specific Triquilt debut year not cleanly sourced, held null.

description: The Fendigraphy is Fendi's hobo introduced by Kim Jones in the Fall/Winter 2022 collection, a smooth crescent-shaped shoulder bag with a curved base that reveals a metallic Fendi logo along the bottom when worn. It is a modern reinterpretation of the classic hobo silhouette and comes in several sizes, from a large shoulder bag down to a small hand-clutched version. It became a fast favorite among celebrities and stylists.

Le Chiquito is Jacquemus' micro handbag, a tiny structured top-handle bag with a small flap and a slim shoulder strap, credited with launching the micro-bag trend. It debuted in the brand's Spring/Summer 2018 collection and became a viral phenomenon, later spawning even smaller versions. Designed by Simon Porte Jacquemus, it is offered in smooth leather across a rotating palette of colors.

The Hop is Bottega Veneta's slouchy shoulder bag introduced by Matthieu Blazy for Spring 2024, a soft, puffy, gathered hobo most often shown in the house's signature Intrecciato woven leather. It has a rounded body designed to sit under the arm or on the shoulder and no external logo hardware. It emerged as one of the new house icons of Blazy's tenure.
